primary_question: Can a frozen symbolic equation selector generalize on previously inaccessible real-world physical measurements from independent scientific domains better than predeclared strong non-symbolic baselines?

disambiguation.external_sealed: Scientific data and ground-truth TEST labels held only by a third-party custodian outside participant-controlled GitHub/CI and unavailable to JANUS before one final submission.
disambiguation.synthetic_smoke: Public deterministic synthetic samples allowed solely to validate the interface; NEVER count toward scientific results.
disambiguation.published_nist: Prior public NIST data are excluded from R1.4 science.

participant_submission.interface: JSON input: {domain_id,train:[[x,y]],validation:[[x,y]],test_x:[x]}. Return {model_status, predictions:[y], frozen_source_sha, scientific_claim:NO_CLAIM}. Holdout y MUST NOT be in input.
participant_submission.frozen_learner: R1.2 analytic grammar and validation selector, reused via r12_discover.case_discovery, not trained against R1.3 holdout.
participant_submission.allowed_data: normalized x in [0,1], finite scalar y; scale/normalization fixed by organizer from public TRAIN domain bounds before final TEST; input contains no source file name, labels, or public dataset IDs
participant_submission.runtime: Python 3.11 stdlib only, deterministic, bounded runtime and memory; external custodian isolates the container

criteria: Direct observed measurements, not formula-generated labels
External independent acquisition/provenance and rights confirmed by custodian
At least 30 unique x per domain, with non-overlapping group-wise TEST
TRAIN/VALIDATION values provided, TEST labels sealed
Test provenance and sampling protocol retained by evaluator and committed in signed receipt
exclusions: Any domain where JANUS has already accessed sealed labels

strong_baselines.selection: Custodian independently fits baselines on TRAIN, chooses by VALIDATION; TEST used exactly once.
families: UnivariateSpline with smoothing 0.01/0.1/1.0 scaled train sigma

uncertainty.resampling: Paired bootstrap by independent TEST x-groups, 2000 resamples, fixed seed1301; percentile 95% interval for gain
uncertainty.limitations: Descriptive conditional CI for frozen predictors. With small groups and correlated physical observations it is not a universal inference or full laboratory replicate.
uncertainty.report_abstention: Explicit, always count as not winning. No post-hoc replacing with baseline to claim novelty.
uncertainty.scoring_gate: 3/3 distinct physical domains each PROPOSE, gain >= 5%, 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.

trust_gate.requirement: Independent custodian signs canonical result JSON with Ed25519; public key must be pinned by independent verification before receipt is accepted. GitHub Actions fixture or researcher-generated keys are not evidence.
trust_gate.cryptographic_note: Signature authenticates a separately verified key identity and exact bytes; it does not establish honesty by itself. Never auto-trust arbitrary self-submitted key.

comparison_to_R13: R1.4 uses frozen R1.2 learner and R1.3 strong baselines without reading R1.3 TEST again; independent domains held outside JANUS.
theological_boundary: No possible numeric score can establish or refute divine authorship; mathematics/physics interpretation separate from empirical fit.
other_boundaries: Do not write scientific PASS without external signed receipt
